|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-81-Blizzard_2.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-D-blizzard2-pre.gif]]) on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB2-81-Blizzard_2-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may ▲ one Trample or Walker Barrage. Walker Barrage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 56). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Blizzard 2 (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) reads “Walker Barage total” for “Walker Barrage total” (typo as published) (it writes ▲ out as “take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, which is notation only): “May add 1 pilot and 8 passengers. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. During your control phase, may take one Trample or Walker Barrage into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Walker Barage total is +2. Immune to attrition < 4.”<ref name="cl-1220_81-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205214/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2012-12-11] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11; the captures of March to May 2013 carry no game text</ref>
